info.title: Matcha API
info.description: Use **Try it out** on POST /auth/login with a verified account. The browser sends the resulting session cookie on subsequent requests from this page. Use the same hostname throughout, such as localhost.

get.description: Browser-only redirect from Google. Verifies state and PKCE, exchanges the code, then creates or links a verified account using the normal Matcha session cookie. Errors return to the login page with `google=denied`, `invalid`, `unavailable`, `pending`, `conflict`, or `rate_limited`.
